nodes.description: The initiating lesion is a heterozygous germline variant in OPN1SW (chromosome 7), the gene for the S-cone opsin. Reported alleles are missense substitutions (L56P, G79R, T190I, S214P, P264S, R283Q), all except T190I in transmembrane helices, and an intron 3 splice-donor deletion. The alleles were found in tritan probands or families; where controls were screened, the variants were absent from them.

nodes.description: Blue-yellow (tritan) colour discrimination depends on comparing S-cone signals with combined L- and M-cone signals. nodes.description: Mutant S-opsin is predicted to misfold or be unstable. Because each S cone expresses both OPN1SW alleles, whereas each L or M cone expresses a single X-linked opsin gene, mutant and normal S-opsin are made in the same cell, which allows a dominant-negative interaction of the kind seen with dominant rhodopsin mutations. No folding or trafficking assay of a tritan allele has been reported in the sources cited here.

nodes.description: Mouse lacking S-opsin expression.
